title: lithocarpus pallidus
intro: Lithocarpus pallidus, commonly known as the pale-barked Lithocarpus or pale-barked Lithocarpus, is a plant species in the beech family Fagaceae. It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against diseases such as cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus pallidus include anti-oxidative stress, anti-inflammatory, and anti-viral effects, which can help to alleviate symptoms of various conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Lithocarpus pallidus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
